hook: Thiel co-founded PayPal in 1998 and, after its 2002 sale to eBay, co-founded the data analytics company Palantir Technologies in 2003 and the venture firm Founders Fund in 2005. He serves as chairman of Palantir and as a partner at Founders Fund.
name: Peter Thiel
moniker: Co-founder, Palantir Technologies and Founders Fund

primary.name: Founders Fund, Peter Thiel team page

timeline.event: Co-founds PayPal with Max Levchin and Luke Nosek
timeline.impact: Serves as CEO through the company's growth
Provides capital Thiel uses for subsequent ventures
Becomes chairman of the data analytics company

timeline.event: Co-founds Founders Fund with Ken Howery and Luke Nosek
timeline.impact: Raises the firm's first fund of 50 million dollars from entrepreneurs and angel investors

quick_facts: Co-founder and chairman of Palantir Technologies, founded in 2003
Co-founder and partner at Founders Fund, established in 2005 with Ken Howery and Luke Nosek
Co-founded PayPal in 1998 and served as its CEO until its 2002 sale to eBay
Runs the Thiel Fellowship through the Thiel Foundation, providing grants to young entrepreneurs

achievements.title: Co-founder and Chairman, Palantir Technologies
achievements.impact: Co-founded the data analytics company in 2003 alongside Stephen Cohen, Joe Lonsdale, Alex Karp and Nathan Gettings, and has chaired its board since inception.

achievements.title: Co-founder, Founders Fund
achievements.impact: Co-founded the venture capital firm in 2005 with Ken Howery and Luke Nosek, raising its first fund the same year.

achievements.title: Co-founder and CEO, PayPal
achievements.impact: Co-founded the online payments company in 1998 and led it as CEO through its 2002 sale to eBay for 1.5 billion dollars.
